lemma.statement: Let S be a reachable nonterminal canonical CNF state of PIRC_DECISION_CORE_V0_4 with at least one live root variable, root-relative input budget N, and state_units s. If some nondegenerate literal pair (a,b) co-occurs in t clauses with t >= s-2N+11, then the frozen exhaustive v2 B2 macro lane is guaranteed to admit an exact strict-progress root-rescue move under the N^2 state cap.
proof: v2 enumerates every nondegenerate literal pair that co-occurs in a live clause in canonical order, so the pair (a,b) is deterministically reached unless an earlier pair already succeeds.

Replacing (a,b) by -e in each of t clauses removes one literal occurrence per replaced clause and leaves clause count unchanged for those clauses. The three exact definition clauses (-e,-a),(-e,-b),(e,a,b) add 3 clause units and 7 literal units, total 10 units.
Therefore before any beneficial canonical duplicate/subsumption cleanup, macro state_units <= s-t+10.
By TWO_N_MINUS_ONE_ELIMINATION_CORRIDOR, exact Davis-Putnam elimination of every live pivot in the macro CNF fits the N^2 cap.

The B2 macro is a definitional extension and does not eliminate original variables; while a root was live before the macro, at least one root remains available for roots_only elimination. v2 scans the frozen root order and therefore finds a capped root pivot.

That root elimination decreases the live-root count by one. The frozen potential phi=r*(n+N^2+1)+v strictly decreases because the macro adds at most one live extension while root elimination removes one live root, whereas the lost root coefficient n+N^2+1 is strictly larger than any possible +1 live-variable change.
Exact macro replay plus exact capped elimination therefore satisfy all v2 admission gates.
